BackstoryDef.title: cursed lab experiment
BackstoryDef.description: Once a lowly janitor caught stealing supplies in a secret pre-war facility, [PAWN_nameDef] was subjected to a cruel experimental mutagen trial. As [PAWN_possessive] mind fractured and [PAWN_possessive] body swelled to monstrous proportions, [PAWN_pronoun] tore free of [PAWN_possessive] restraints and vanished into the ruins.

BackstoryDef.title: behemoth of the depths
BackstoryDef.description: A towering legend whispered about across the wasteland, [PAWN_nameDef] slumbers beneath stagnant waters and sunken ruins until intruders disturb [PAWN_possessive] territory. Driven by primal rage and utter contempt for fragile humans, [PAWN_pronoun] crushes entire squads with colossal strength.

BackstoryDef.title: pit fighter mutant
BackstoryDef.description: Raised in the brutal hierarchy of a wild mutant warband, [PAWN_nameDef] learned that only the loudest roar and hardest punch earned respect. [PAWN_pronoun] spent [PAWN_possessive] early years smashing boulders and battering smaller kin into submission.

BackstoryDef.title: berserker warlord
BackstoryDef.description: Seizing command of a fortified tower after tearing the previous chief apart, [PAWN_nameDef] leads [PAWN_possessive] warband with blind fury and heavy gunfire. [PAWN_pronoun] despises humans as weak, noisy insects fit only to be crushed beneath mutant boots.

BackstoryDef.title: ruin stalker
BackstoryDef.description: Unlike [PAWN_possessive] loud, reckless brethren, [PAWN_nameDef] preferred perching atop crumbling overpasses to watch stray wastelanders from afar. [PAWN_pronoun] practiced picking off mutated birds and distant targets with salvaged rifles until [PAWN_pronoun] rarely missed.

BackstoryDef.title: mutant sharpshooter
BackstoryDef.description: Unusually patient for a wild super mutant, [PAWN_nameDef] commands the marksmen of the warband from high vantage points. [PAWN_pronoun] takes cold satisfaction in pinning down human patrols with precise, lethal fire before the berserkers charge in.

BackstoryDef.title: wreckage scavenger
BackstoryDef.description: Obsessed with rusted car frames, leaking fuel drums, and roaring explosions, [PAWN_nameDef] spent [PAWN_possessive] youth dragging highway wrecks back to the mutant camp. [PAWN_pronoun] loved loud noises and bright fire far more than talking.

BackstoryDef.title: frenzied charger
BackstoryDef.description: Driven by a manic addiction to speed, smoke, and deafening blasts, [PAWN_nameDef] leads suicidal vanguard charges straight into enemy barricades. [PAWN_pronoun] laughs wildly under heavy fire, eager to blow human defenses to pieces.

BackstoryDef.title: gore-bag apprentice
BackstoryDef.description: Assigned to tend the grim hanging bags and trophy piles of a mutant lair, [PAWN_nameDef] grew up elbow-deep in blood and scrap iron. [PAWN_pronoun] developed a twisted pride in keeping [PAWN_possessive] crude cleavers razor-sharp.

BackstoryDef.title: feral slaughterer
BackstoryDef.description: Towering over the blood-stained chopping blocks of the warband, [PAWN_nameDef] hacks apart wasteland beasts and unfortunate captives with equal glee. In battle, [PAWN_pronoun] wades into melee swinging heavy blades, treating humans like livestock.
